text: Edge-restoring net held within a brightness/contrast corridor (implicit eye adaptation)
description: One net restores clean edges each frame and keeps global stats (mean luminance, contrast, maybe saturation) inside target bands. Loss: penalise only when the stats leave the corridor, with slow targets, so entering a dark space lights up implicitly over a few seconds. Related: fabric-artwork src/auto-color-grade.ts (mip-averaged luminance stats, 10/90% quantiles).

status.comment: train.corridor (train.py corridor()): per sample, zero loss while the prediction's mean luminance stays within truth +-0.05 and its luminance std >= 0.8x truth's, linear outside. Unit check: same frame 0, slightly darker 0, fog (flat) 0.13, 0.2 darker 0.15. Targets are the real frame's stats (not slow-adapting targets yet). Pending: A/B training run (after the dropout A/B frees the CPU).
